milestones.outcome: Attended-review sessions can optionally announce themselves to a configured hub without any effect on review when the hub is absent or failing.
exit_criteria: The publisher sends the version-1 record at every defined point against a fixture hub, and unchanged behavior holds with no hub or a failing hub.
milestones.boundary: A released attended-review client and record contract, usable before any hub exists.

milestones.outcome: The owner can open one tailnet-only page on the NAS that lists every active review across machines and links to each.
exit_criteria: The compose stack serves the identity-restricted hub over Tailscale Serve only, with listing, stale handling and no influence on review state.

milestones.outcome: The owner's Android phone is notified when a session gains ready items, without anything leaving the tailnet.
exit_criteria: Throttled, content-free ntfy messages reach a subscribed device through a locked-down tailnet-only ntfy server.
milestones.boundary: The complete defined hub outcome with closeout evidence; iOS stays deferred.
